nodes.label: Remove the Daily Plan
nodes.rationale: Delete the daily-puzzle feature everywhere and reframe the launcher as a free-play hub whose hook is per-mode personal-best high scores. Two phases so the app is shippable after Phase A; Phase B then deletes the now-unreachable best-of-N machinery test-first.

nodes.label: Launcher as free-play high-score hub
nodes.rationale: With the daily gone the launcher needs a different hook; per-mode personal bests replace the daily calendar/streak as the retention surface, and header, visibility rules, and telemetry all move with it in one task so no intermediate commit ships a launcher with nothing to show.

nodes.label: Best-of-N machinery deletion (Phase B)
nodes.rationale: Deferred to its own phase because after Phase A the best-of-N reducer capability is present but unreachable — safe to ship, and deleting it test-first keeps the reducer's regression net meaningful. Task order guarantees typecheck and the unit suite stay green after every commit: readers of a symbol are removed before the symbol, and each telemetry event type dies in the same commit as its last call site.

nodes.label: One-time legacy daily-storage cleanup
nodes.rationale: Existing users carry daily history, resume blobs, and streak keys in localStorage; a one-time cleanup runs first so no later task has to reason about orphaned keys, and returning users are not left with unreadable state.
